$comment: MAINNET PrivateFPC deployment descriptor — the per-network sibling of private-fpc-canonical.json (testnet). Mainnet's canonical rollup runs the installed 6.0.0 line, so the artifact, salt and address equal testnet's; only the network pins differ. Consumed by check-fpc-version.ts, which selects the descriptor whose network pins match the live node, and by aztec-line.ts, which refuses every send to a network whose descriptor is not the installed line's. Machine-asserted by private-fuel.test.ts.

network.$comment: Hard identity pins for Aztec MAINNET: l1ChainId 1 and the canonical rollup's version 2070860440 (the registry's getCanonicalRollup and node_getNodeInfo agree; wallet chain id (1 ^ 2070860440) >>> 0 = 2070860441). The registry still lists the retired 5.0.1 rollup (4248422647); nothing here may target it.

compatibleNodeVersions.$comment: HUMAN-CURATED, digest-keyed: node versions this exact artifact may run against. 6.0.0 = the artifact's own version, which the mainnet node reports. A new artifact digest requires fresh curation, never inherited compat.
